forks.name: fluidd
forks.title: Fluidd
forks.why: Pinned to the v1.37.5 release (promoted 2026-09-13 after a live trial; the printer's own Fluidd is 1.30.0-f3e4ac3 and branch cfs-1.30.0 keeps that build). The fork adds the CFS card, the CFS and Camera pages, a creality-webrtc camera service and an HTTP fallback for the three access calls this Moonraker lacks on the websocket.

forks.name: orcaslicer
forks.title: OrcaSlicer
forks.why: Branch cfs adds the Creality CFS (K2) print host type. The fork tracks upstream main, not releases: the pinned base is main at 3e1daccd7c (rebased 2026-09-15), which is the base the shipped build was compiled from.
